description: Search the U.S. Small Business Administration's public Small Business Search directory by name/keyword, US state, NAICS industry code, or federal certification. No login required.

activeSamOnly.description: Only return businesses with an active federal SAM.gov registration.
activeSamOnly.title: Active SAM.gov registration only

certificationFilter.description: Extra client-side filter: only keep records with this active certification.
certificationFilter.title: Post-filter: certification

certifications.description: Restrict to businesses holding one of these active SBA certifications.
certifications.title: Federal certifications (mode=byCertification)

congressionalDistricts.description: Restrict results to these US congressional districts, e.g. `TX-21` or `Texas-21`. Use `-00` for at-large single-district states (e.g. `Wyoming-00`) and `-98` for the non-voting delegate districts of DC, Puerto Rico, Guam, the US Virgin Islands, American Samoa, and the Northern Mariana Islands.
congressionalDistricts.title: US congressional districts

countyFips.description: Restrict results to these 5-digit US county FIPS codes (2-digit state + 3-digit county), e.g. `48453` for Travis County, TX. Look up codes on the Census Bureau's county FIPS reference.
countyFips.title: Counties (5-digit FIPS codes)

includePreviousCertifications.description: Also include businesses whose certification has since expired or been suspended.
includePreviousCertifications.title: Include lapsed/previous certifications

keywords.description: Restrict to businesses tagged with any of these exact keyword/capability tags (case-insensitive exact match, OR'd together). This is distinct from `searchTerm`, which does a broader free-text match across name/narrative/tags.
keywords.title: Keyword tags (exact match, OR-matched)

lastUpdated.description: Only include businesses whose profile was last updated within this time window.
lastUpdated.title: Profile last updated within

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted business records.
maxItems.title: Max items

minConstructionBondingAggregate.description: Only return businesses whose reported aggregate construction bonding capacity is at least this many US dollars.
minConstructionBondingAggregate.title: Min construction bonding level (aggregate, USD)

minConstructionBondingIndividual.description: Only return businesses whose reported individual/per-contract construction bonding capacity is at least this many US dollars.
minConstructionBondingIndividual.title: Min construction bonding level (per-contract, USD)

minServiceBondingAggregate.description: Only return businesses whose reported aggregate service bonding capacity is at least this many US dollars.
minServiceBondingAggregate.title: Min service bonding level (aggregate, USD)

minServiceBondingIndividual.description: Only return businesses whose reported individual/per-contract service bonding capacity is at least this many US dollars.
minServiceBondingIndividual.title: Min service bonding level (per-contract, USD)

minYearEstablished.description: Drop businesses established before this year.
minYearEstablished.title: Post-filter: min year established

msaCodes.description: Restrict results to these 5-digit Census metropolitan statistical area (MSA/CBSA) codes, e.g. `12420` for Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Look up codes on the Census Bureau's CBSA delineation file or via the SBA's own Advanced Search 'Metropolitan statistical area' picker.
msaCodes.title: Metro areas (MSA/CBSA codes)

naicsCodes.description: Precise 2-6 digit NAICS codes (e.g. `722310` for food-service contractors). Combine with `naicsSector` for a broader net.
naicsCodes.title: Exact NAICS codes (mode=byNaicsCode)

naicsPrefixFilter.description: Extra client-side filter: only keep records with a NAICS code starting with this prefix.
naicsPrefixFilter.title: Post-filter: NAICS code prefix

naicsPrimaryOnly.description: Only match businesses whose PRIMARY NAICS code is in the given list (instead of any of their listed codes).
naicsPrimaryOnly.title: Match primary NAICS only

naicsSector.description: Top-level industry sector to browse. Applied as a client-side refinement (the upstream API only exact-matches NAICS codes) — pair with `searchTerm`, `naicsCodes`, `states`, or `certifications` for a well-narrowed search.
enumTitles: 21 - Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction
53 - Real Estate and Rental and Leasing
56 - Administrative and Support and Waste Management Services
naicsSector.title: NAICS sector (mode=byNaicsCode)

qualityStandards.description: Restrict to businesses that hold these quality assurance certifications.
qualityStandards.title: Quality assurance standards

requireWebsite.description: Only keep records that have a public website URL.
requireWebsite.title: Require a website

searchTerm.description: Business name, UEI, CAGE code, or keyword (matches capabilities narrative and tags too). Note: SBA's own search does raw substring matching across a large free-text narrative field, not word-boundary matching — a common term (e.g. "bakery") can surface loosely-related businesses whose name or narrative merely contains a similar-looking substring (e.g. a firm with "Baker" in its name). This is an upstream search-relevance characteristic, not something this actor filters — for precise results, combine with `states`/`naicsCodes`/`certifications`.
searchTerm.title: Search term

selfCertifications.description: Restrict to businesses that self-attested to these ownership traits in SAM.gov. These are not independently verified by SBA (unlike the federal `certifications` above).

enumTitles: Self-Certified Woman-Owned Small Business Joint Venture
Community Development Corporation (CDC) Owned Small Business
Alaskan Native Corp (ANC) Owned Small Business
Native Hawaiian Org (NHO) Owned Small Business

selfCertifications.title: Self-certifications (SAM.gov, non-federal)

stateFilter.description: Extra client-side filter: drop records not located in this state (2-letter code or full name). Useful alongside other modes.
stateFilter.title: Post-filter: state

states.description: Restrict results to businesses located in these states/territories.
states.title: US states (mode=byState)

zipCodes.description: Restrict results to these 5-digit ZIP codes.
zipCodes.title: ZIP codes

title: SBA Small Business Search Scraper Input
